description:
Spacious 4BR House with Terrace, Garden & Barbecue | Near Munich, Airport & Allianz Arena

Welcome to your spacious and comfortable home near Munich – perfect for families, groups, or trips with friends. With 4 bedrooms, a terrace, garden, and barbecue, it’s ideal for relaxed stays together. Conveniently located between the airport and the Allianz Arena, with quick access to the city.

📍 Perfect location: Ideally located between the airport and the Allianz Arena – perfect for Munich trips, business stays, football fans, and Oktoberfest visitors.

🛏️ 4 bedrooms – ideal for families, large groups, or friends traveling together.

🛁 Bathroom with shower and bathtub, plus 3 separate toilets (one on each floor) – especially convenient for larger groups.

🍽️ Fully equipped kitchen & spacious dining area – perfect for shared meals and relaxed evenings together.

🏡 Comfortable, well-equipped home: Fast 1000 Mbit/s Wi-Fi, blackout blinds, washing machine, and everything you need for an easy, stress-free stay.

💡 Need local tips? I’m happy to share my favorite spots and insider recommendations for Munich. Looking forward to hosting you!

The neighborhood
Discover Neufahrn, Freising, and Munich!
Neufahrn bei Freising offers the perfect balance of relaxation and adventure. Stroll through the charming pedestrian zone, enjoy fresh pastries at local bakeries, or unwind by the peaceful Mühlseen lakes. Thrill-seekers will love the nearby indoor skydiving center and glow-in-the-dark mini-golf.

Thanks to excellent transport connections, you can reach Munich’s vibrant city center in just 30 minutes by S-Bahn. Explore iconic sights like Marienplatz, the English Garden, Viktualienmarkt, and the world-famous Allianz Arena.

Munich Airport (MUC) is just 10 minutes away – ensuring easy and stress-free travel. Don’t miss a visit to Freising, a beautiful historic town known for its impressive cathedral and the world’s oldest brewery.

After a day full of discoveries, return to the calm and comfort of Neufahrn — where you can relax and recharge for your next adventure. Whether you're traveling for business, sightseeing, or a family getaway, you’ll enjoy the best of both worlds!
